name: Helin Kandemir
bio: Helin Kandemir (born 2 June 2004) is a Turkish actress. She received the Best Actress Award at the International Istanbul Film Festival for her role in the movie Kız Kardeşler.

credits.title: Last Meal
credits.overview: The passionate love between pianist Sebahat and Bekir is cut short when he vanishes without a trace. Years later, when fate reunites them, they realize that neither time, distance, nor the life Sebahat has built could ever break their bond. Together, they embark on a journey that pushes the very limits of love, loyalty

credits.title: Djinn Wedding
credits.overview: When four estranged siblings reunite in their remote Anatolian village for their sister’s wedding, long-buried memories begin to resurface. credits.title: Aşkın Yüzü
credits.overview: High school student Özgür has a rare disease: face blindness. When he meets Özlem, he feels a magical connection and wants to pursue love for the first time in his life. But his disease causes a huge problem that Özlem needs to solve.

credits.title: Bihter: A Forbidden Passion
credits.overview: Bihter, who is desperate for love, sees Adnan, a wealthy and respected older guy, as a way out of the stereotype that society and her materialistic mother have given her. But she soon discovers that she is not satisfied with his attention and has other needs.

credits.title: Private Lesson
credits.overview: Posing as a private tutor, Azra secretly coaches students on achieving their goals in life and love — but not without a few bumps in the road.

credits.title: Paranoya!
credits.overview: Gözde leaves her friends one evening and gets on a minibus to go home. However, after a while, she realizes she is alone, and the minibus has turned onto an unfamiliar, dark road.

credits.title: Stuck Apart
credits.overview: Entrenched in a midlife crisis, Aziz seeks solace from his mundane job, lonesome friends and rowdy family while pretending to have his act together.

credits.title: A Tale of Three Sisters
credits.overview: A stagnant and gloomy village in the 1980s. Reyhan, Nurhan, and Havva, three sisters were sent to town as 'besleme' (foster child and maid).
